desc: The USB-588-T Turbo High Candela USB Dual-Light Rechargeable Tactical Flashlight features a flashlight rated at 1100 lumens, in addition to a 350-lumen downward-facing flood light. Utilizing a revised LED and bezel dimensions, the USB-588T produces 85,000 Candela, with a beam distance of 547 meters. In Dual-Light mode, the USB-588T puts out a combined 850 lumens. At only 6 inches long and weighing only 5.9 oz, this metal tactical flashlight is multi-functional, cycling between high, medium, and low modes.
